changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: Three customers with fixed ids so order-service demo requests can name them.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO customer (id, email, phone, first_name, last_name, status_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT v.id::uuid, v.email, v.phone, v.first_name, v.last_name, s.id, now(), now() FROM (VALUES ('b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 'ivan.petrov@example.com', '+79161234567', 'Иван', 'Петров', 'ACTIVE'), ('b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', 'maria.ivanova@example.com', '+79219876543', 'Мария', 'Иванова', 'ACTIVE'), ('b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', 'sergey.smirnov@example.com', '+79031112233', 'Сергей', 'Смирнов', 'NEW') ) AS v(id, email, phone, first_name, last_name, status_code) JOIN customer_status s ON s.code = v.status_code;

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: Ivan keeps two addresses: the default one and a second to ask for by id. The rows are aged apart on purpose — now() is transaction time, identical for the whole statement, and the successor of a deleted default is picked by created_at.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO address (id, customer_id, city_id, street, building, apartment, postal_code, is_default, created_at, updated_at) SELECT v.id::uuid, v.customer_id::uuid, c.id, v.street, v.building, v.apartment, v.postal_code, v.is_default, now() - v.age::interval, now() - v.age::interval FROM (VALUES ('c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 'MSK', 'Дмитровское шоссе', '9к3', '154', '127434', true, '4 days'), ('c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 'MSK', 'Ленинский проспект', '42', '7', '119071', false, '3 days'), ('c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', 'SPB', 'Пулковское шоссе', '14', '203', '196158', true, '2 days'), ('c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004', 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', 'EKB', 'Кольцовский тракт', '5', NULL, '620025', true, '1 day') ) AS v(id, customer_id, city_code, street, building, apartment, postal_code, is_default, age) JOIN city c ON c.code = v.city_code;
